$comment: GPU backend switch for Imagination Studio by keys+Wasserman.
Change 'mode' with ./studio-gpu.sh use local|runpod — it also writes the app's own placement record.
Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> before use. Never commit real pod IPs, keys or API tokens.

labels.$comment: Friendly names for the Sparks tab's 'Render on' dropdown. Written to $STUDIO_HOME/sparks/labels.json, which the app only ever reads (app/sparks.py:510).
labels.head: This Mac

local.label: This Mac
local.$comment: These are the installer's own gates (oneshot-setup.sh:261-280). Below 'min' it dies at preflight — not advisory.

runpod.label: Runpod GPU pod
runpod.$comment: pod_as_studio runs the whole Studio on the pod and you browse it over an ssh tunnel — the only shape that works when the Mac is below 48 GB. pod_as_worker keeps the Studio local and hands single video clips to the pod (app/sparks.py KINDS == ('video',)); it cannot rescue a host that cannot render pictures.

requirements.$comment: Measured in GPU memory. Floor is 90 GB for the video install without weight streaming (oneshot-setup-cuda.sh:201); 64 GB system RAM is unconditional (line 202).

placement.$comment: Written into $STUDIO_HOME/sparks/sparks.json. 'head' means this machine (app/sparks.py:566). 'prefer' falls back to the other backend; 'require' fails instead.

studio.$comment: Where the app is installed and where it keeps projects, renders and its own config. STUDIO_HOME overrides at runtime.
